welcomeDesc: Hello, I am Emirkan. I build scalable backend services and user-focused web applications with Java, Spring Boot, and React.
javaScript: JavaScript is the most commonly used programming language for adding interactivity to websites. With this language, actions such as clicking buttons or filling out forms on web pages become dynamic. Today, it is used not only in browsers but also on servers thanks to Node.js technology. With this feature, JavaScript is a versatile language that can be used for both frontend and backend development. In short, JavaScript is one of the fundamental building blocks of the modern internet, and learning it is a major step forward in the world of software development.
reactJs: ReactJS is a JavaScript-based library used for building user interfaces. It was developed by Facebook and is one of the most popular frontend technologies today. Thanks to its component-based structure, React allows code to be more organized, reusable, and easy to manage. In addition to its Virtual DOM structure, it enables web pages to update quickly and improves performance. In short, ReactJS is an excellent tool for developing modern, fast, and scalable web applications.
Java: Java is a powerful, object-oriented programming language designed for building high-performance and platform-independent applications. Thanks to the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), Java applications can run on different operating systems without modification ('write once, run anywhere'). On the server side, Java is widely used for backend development, especially through frameworks such as Spring and Spring Boot. Its multi-threaded architecture, robust memory management (garbage collection), and rich standard libraries enable developers to build secure, scalable, and maintainable systems. Additionally, Java has a strong ecosystem supported by dependency management tools like Maven and Gradle. In short, Java is a reliable and efficient choice for modern software development, particularly for large-scale and long-lived backend solutions.
profileAboutMeAnsw: As a Full-Stack Developer specialized in Java, Spring Boot, and React, I focus on building scalable backend services and modern web applications. I prioritize OOP, data structures, and clean architecture principles to deliver sustainable, testable, and maintainable software. I actively worked on real-world projects using REST APIs, Spring Data JPA layers, and responsive React interfaces.
